title: Publish a carousel with confirmation
description: Publishes an exported carousel (id, or exportDir inside the data dir) to targets: instagram, linkedin, facebook, tiktok, or all for every wired one. Optional caption, captionFile, title, dryRun. Two steps: a dry run describes exactly what would be sent and returns metadata.confirmToken; posting needs confirm: PUBLISH plus that confirmToken. A dry run always wins.
phrases: post the carousel to instagram and linkedin
send this carousel to every connected platform
show me what publishing this carousel would send

safety.rule: Require confirm: PUBLISH for this exact request every time, together with the confirmToken from a dry run of the same request.
safety.notes: Publishing is irreversible and reaches a real audience. Without the confirmation the recipe only returns a dry run. Any dryRun value other than false, "false", 0 or an empty string is a dry run. Only exports inside the data dir with a passed layout check are accepted. Every attempt is written to the publish log.
